snapshot.text: The company refines oil, makes petrochemicals, and also runs retail stores, mobile and broadband services, and media businesses in India.
Its retail arm serves shoppers in stores and online, plus 4 Mn+ business customers such as small shops, hotels and restaurants.
Its telecom arm, Jio, sells mobile and home internet services and had a total customer base of 542.4 Mn in July–September 2026.
In July–September 2026, Jio Platforms listed on the stock market after India's largest IPO, which raised ₹30,188 crore.
In July–September 2026, the company reported its highest-ever quarterly net profit, at ₹29,550 crore.
In July–September 2026, the retail arm opened 303 stores but closed weak ones, so its net store count fell by 222.
The company launched its Campa drinks brand in Kenya and in Australian supermarkets Coles and Woolworths, backed by local production in Australia.
The company has started 6 new food and beverage factory projects across the country.

watch.title: Retail online scale to value
watch.text: Retail says online scale should convert into value; watch whether that happens.

watch.title: Festive season in electronics
watch.text: Consumer electronics aims to win festive sales, accepting lower margins to gain customers.

watch.title: Oil demand rebound
watch.text: Company expects global oil demand to rebound by 2.0 mb/d, supporting refining.

watch.title: Coal bed methane wells
watch.text: Second phase of a 40-well gas campaign is ongoing; completion adds production.

events.text: ICRA reaffirmed top debt ratings and assigned its highest rating to new bank loan facilities.
Second new ethane carrier ship was received, after one earlier ship became operational.
